title: Applied ML Weekly Notes - 2026-05-12
content:
Week of 2026-05-12 - Applied ML team weekly notes (standup + research updates)

Attendees: Alex Chen (owner), Priya Nair, Carlos Martinez, Samir Gupta, Maya Patel, plus guests from serving-runtime (Lena) and console (Jordan) for onboarding sync.

Overview / goals this week:
- Continue quantization experiments for 13B family (int8 + group-wise aware quant) to hit <=2x perf regression vs fp16 while saving >=3x memory.
- Run eval regression sweep across curated prompt sets before onboarding new model variants to hosted catalog.
- Stabilize model-onboarding checklist, add automated post-deploy evals and alerts.

Standup highlights (daily snippets):
- Alex: Quantization baseline runs finished for llama-2-13b (8-bit symmetric + per-channel scales). Observed 10-12% BLEU-style metric drop on code prompts; chat/QA metrics mostly within noise. Started kernel tuning on A100/RTX6000. TODO: open perf ticket with infra (JIRA-ML-847).
- Priya: Evals harness enhancements - added dynamic prompt sampling and stratified bucketing for long-tail prompts. Ran regression sweep against canary candidate (llama-2-13b-int8-gqa). Found 3 failing prompts (hallucination/regression). Created bug triage ticket JIRA-ML-843.
- Carlos: Model onboarding infra - working on runtime config defaults for quantized variants and adding KV cache sanity checks. Demoed local flow for private deployment. Need to finalize config schema (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/rw-platform/pull/998).
- Samir: Cost/perf analysis - projected 35% cost reduction on token compute for int8 q8_0 variant under typical batching vs fp16. Need to validate under burst patterns.
- Maya: Eval labeling batch (50 prompts) for edge-case hallucinations; 12 labeled as regressions. Coordinating with Priya on remediation.

Meeting notes - Deep-dive: Quantization experiments (Wed 10:30)
- Goal: understand quality vs perf tradeoffs of 8-bit quantization schemes (symmetric int8, asymmetric, group-wise quant, GPTQ variants).
- Setup: run same eval suite (consolidated prompts: chat, code generation, summarization, long-context QA) across fp16 baseline, int8-symm, int8-gqa, and q4/q5 prototypes.
- Results summary:
  - Int8-symm: ~1.8-2.2x memory reduction, 12% slowdown in throughput on A100 when using default kernels, quality drop small for chat but more pronounced for code tasks.
  - Int8-gqa (group-wise scales): similar memory reduction, better quality (only ~4% drop on code tasks), throughput improvements after kernel tweaks (~10-15%).
  - GPTQ-like methods: best quality but increased quantization time and more complex on-device CPU schedules.
- Action items:
  - Priya/Carlos: benchmark int8-gqa with custom kernel flags on dedicated nodes (priority: A100 and T4) - due 2026-05-16 (JIRA-ML-847, ML-848).
  - Alex: open follow-up with research to test mixed-precision fallback heuristics for code generation prompts (AM-202).

Evals & regression checks
- New eval harness updates shipped to staging (branch: evals/stratified-sampling).
- Ran sweep over 12K prompts (stratified across length and domain). Canary model (llama-2-13b-int8-gqa) passed aggregate thresholds but failed 0.03% of prompts that are high-value (billing impact).
- Investigations into failing prompts show pattern: long-context code completion with specific tokenization edge-cases leading to truncated completions.
- Short-term mitigation: add post-processing normalization and tokenization-aligned prompt templates for onboarding candidates.
- Longer-term: integrate tokenizer-aware sampling into training/eval and add unit tests.

Model onboarding status
- Candidate: llama-2-13b-int8-gqa (internal tag: ll2-13b-q8g-202605).
- Onboarding checklist status:
  - Security review: pending (security ticket SEC-415 assigned to Maya).
  - Inference profile: perf numbers captured for dedicated nodes, need hosted API run with burst tests.
  - Evals: regression sweep done; 3 medium-impact prompts flagged.
  - Docs & example prompts: draft ready (docs PR pending).
- Next steps: hold canary rollout to staging once kernel perf run completes and security signoff. Expected timeline: canary in staging by 2026-05-20.

Open experiments / notes
- Kernel autotune: Lena (serving-runtime) to run autotuner on A100 with group-wise quant kernels - results expected 2 business days.
- Mixed-precision fallback: prototype needed for low-confidence tokens - research spike (Samir) to explore heuristics + cost impact.
- Eval drift monitoring: implement rolling eval on 10k sample traffic daily (priority for hosted tier customers).

Blockers / risks
- Kernel perf on some GPU types (older T4s) is worse; may need specialized kernels or fallbacks that reduce latency SLO on hosted tiers. (Risk: impacts Dedicated customers with mixed backend allocation.)
- Security review delays could push onboarding timeline by 1 week.
- Unknown edge-case tokenization bug in code completions - needs triage with tokenizer team.

Action items (owners & due dates)
- Carlos: finalize config schema PR for quantized variants (PR #998) - due 2026-05-14.
- Priya: re-run regression sweep after kernel tune and triage failing prompts (JIRA-ML-843) - due 2026-05-16.
- Alex: open JIRA-ML-847 for perf infra and coordinate autotune runs with Lena - due 2026-05-13.
- Maya: complete security checklist and schedule review session with SEC team (SEC-415) - due 2026-05-18.
- Samir: run cost simulation under burst traffic patterns and post report to the team channel - due 2026-05-15.

Notes to self / TODOs
- Add a small eval that focuses solely on code tokenization edge-cases; include teams: tokenizer, evals, applied-ml.
- Prepare short deck for next all-hands highlighting cost gains and quality tradeoffs of q8g variant.

Related links / references:
- Quantization roadmap (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/AM/Quantization-Roadmap
- Onboarding checklist (internal): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/AM/Model-Onboarding-Checklist
- Perf infra ticket: JIRA-ML-847
- Eval regression ticket: JIRA-ML-843
- PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/rw-models/pull/482, github.com/redwood-inference/rw-platform/pull/998

Next meeting: Weekly sync + canary review - 2026-05-18 10:30 PT (agenda: kernel perf, eval triage, security signoff).
